ood_signal: Fold-specific EfficientNetV2-S penultimate embeddings -> training-only StandardScaler/PCA/LedoitWolf Mahalanobis + cosine kNN distance

reference_quantiles.important_limitation: This is an internal distribution-distance reference derived from GBM/no-GBM OOF development data. Without a separate external OOD dataset, it is an OOD-likeness signal, not a validated OOD detector.

ood_likeness_candidate_rule: (Mahalanobis >= q95 AND cosine-kNN >= q95) OR either signal >= q99
important_note: Phase 3 Step 4 will fuse this signal with calibrated probability, TTA uncertainty and QC into an indeterminate decision policy.
